title: Run security awareness training
summary: When onboarding people or refreshing the organization's security practices. Role-appropriate training completed by the assigned people with follow-up for observed gaps.
outcomes: Role-appropriate training completed by the assigned people with follow-up for observed gaps.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When onboarding people or refreshing the organization's security practices.

parts.title: Identify relevant roles and security behaviors
parts.guidance: Map workers and contractors to the systems, data and threats they encounter. Include reporting, credential protection, payment fraud and remote work, and distinguish required training from optional material.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve the training and exercise approach
parts.guidance: Security and HR owners select accessible materials and realistic scenarios. Review privacy and employment implications of simulations and avoid collecting credentials or humiliating participants.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve the training and exercise approach

parts.title: Deliver training and safe practice
parts.guidance: The assigned people complete their own training and practice the reporting process. Provide a supported route for questions and accommodations and record participation without treating an agent-generated answer as employee completion.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Assess understanding and operational follow-through
parts.guidance: Review permitted assessment results, reported concerns and recurring errors. Check that staff can find contacts and use the security process rather than relying only on an attendance count.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Assign targeted follow-up and refresh content
parts.guidance: Owners address gaps with appropriate coaching and control changes. Update the material after incidents, system changes or emerging threats and retain the completion evidence under the approved policy.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Assign targeted follow-up and refresh content

verify.how: Role-appropriate training completed by the assigned people with follow-up for observed gaps.
